mechanism.base: Water puts out fire, the old texts say, the way the many overcome the few: rain falls on the blaze until the ground goes dark and quiet. Fire gives the water its work. Over a flame the cold deep warms, moves and has somewhere to go. Water with no heat under it only sits, and heat with nothing deep enough to meet it spends itself on the air and is gone by morning.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Fire, nothing warms the deep: all that water and no flame under it to make it move, and the chance goes unclaimed. Pick one opening this month and see it through.
mechanism.friction_turn: Too much Fire and the water heats through: every warm chance taken at once, the deep boiling off faster than rain can fill it back. Sleep two nights on anything that shines.

catalyst.clause: all that water and no flame under it to make it move
catalyst.remedy: Pick one opening this month and see it through.

friction.clause: every warm chance taken at once, the deep boiling off faster than rain can fill it back
friction.remedy: Sleep two nights on anything that shines.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Fire in you, the warmth that gets the deep moving.
wide.remedy: Spend it on one venture at a time.

missing.clause: No flame anywhere under the deep, where nothing warms and nothing gets claimed.
missing.remedy: Borrow warmth from a friend who starts things.

spared.clause: Nothing here to boil the water off, and the deep keeps what it has.
spared.remedy: Leave it unlit. Let the water stay cool.

thin.clause: A small flame only, not enough to heat the water through.
thin.remedy: Keep it small and let it warm, not boil.

excess.clause: So much fire that the water itself runs hot, steaming away into every bright thing it meets.
excess.remedy: Cool it. Take one chance a season and decline the rest.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, so what you build reaches people in time. As a catalyst, the start comes late, and you want a far chance as much as steady pay. You pay most for what you never claim.
function.definition_friction: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire turns it bright, lit the moment a chance appears. As a friction, the light outruns its fuel, and you chase a new opening rather than keep what you have. You end up starting more than you can feed.
function.advise_catalyst: You feel safer planning a thing than starting it, and the plan is where most of your chances end. Put a date on one venture and begin before it arrives. Ask for the raise instead of waiting for it. Tell the person you love what you want next. Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.
function.advise_friction: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from: sleep, food, the slow fill that comes before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. You spend yourself on every bright chance because stopping feels like losing. Keep one night a week unlit, in bed early. Eat before you say yes to anything.

candidates.cta_verdict: You act on warmth rather than on a plan, and what you start fast is what you most need help keeping.

mechanism.base: The many prevail over the few, and so water governs fire: the rain decides which flames continue, the river decides where the burning stops. Fire is brilliant and outnumbered. Depth arrives without hurry, spends nothing it cannot spare, and the blaze that seemed unstoppable at midnight is steam by morning.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing bright is governed: depth with no stake in the blaze, wisdom watching value burn past. Your chart asks you to claim heat. Step toward the bright loud thing.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the water starts to boil: depth spent on every bright flare, nothing left cool for the long game. Cool it overnight before you move.

catalyst.remedy: Step toward the bright loud thing.

friction.clause: The water starts to boil: depth spent on every bright flare, nothing left cool for the long game.

wide.clause: Fire is all around you, the bright thing your depth should claim.
wide.remedy: Claim one bright chance and see it through.

missing.clause: Nothing bright is governed: depth with no stake in the blaze.
missing.remedy: Borrow fire: step toward one bright thing.

spared.clause: Fire runs absent, and nothing needs damping: no hot chances chased.

thin.clause: Fire runs thin and unwanted: a small blaze, easily enjoyed.

excess.clause: Too much fire heats the water: more bright chances than the depth can cool, boiled off by urgency.
excess.remedy: Step back from the blaze. Add metal.

function.definition_catalyst: Fire is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is the bright opportunity your judgment was built to run: launches, markets, moments that reward the person who read them early. You see clearly where others squint.
function.definition_friction: Fire is your Action, and as a friction, it is urgency pulling on a system that runs deep and slow: hot chances chased, quick pivots made, each one costing more recovery than it returns. Fast money is expensive for you.
function.advise_catalyst: A gift for timing is wasted on a spectator. When your read says now, commit within a week instead of watching it prove you right. Size the bet so a miss stings without sinking. Keep one bright project live at all times.
function.advise_friction: Your edge is patience, so defend it from excitement. Let two opportunities pass for every one you take. Take only what survives a week of waiting. Keep a cooling-off rule for anything urgent, because urgency is usually someone else’s deadline.

$original.cta_verdict: You act by choosing which fires to feed, and your fortune follows the few flames you steady rather than the many you chase.
